### Day 251: Acts 15:22–35
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-251-acts-15-2235.html
Passage: Acts 15:28-29
Points:
- The Jerusalem Council's letter confirmed freedom in Christ while directing Gentile believers toward holy separation.
- The requested abstentions were not legalistic burdens, but practical boundaries designed to safeguard their new liberty.
- Believers are often tempted to view remnants of their former worldly lifestyle as completely harmless.
- Lingering near old worldly customs risks weakening spiritual resolve and causing other believers to stumble.
- True spiritual safety and lasting freedom are found by staying far away from past snares.
